decisions.reason: The implementation packets now reserve exact slice-owned schema, policy, test, documentation, script, telemetry, and role-registry paths. Only explicitly named integration files remain shared and serialized by the dependency graph, and the seed forbids weakening predecessor contracts.

The seed now requires Candidate-bound projection-check.json Evidence for all six pre-merge issue-sync checks. It also distinguishes that readiness proof from bootstrap-closeout.json, which cannot truthfully exist until after maintainer integration and remains mandatory before local terminal completion.
